newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Wolters shares up 3.5 pct ahead of results.
newsitem.headline: Wolters shares up 3.5 pct ahead of results.

text.p: Shares in professional publisher Wolters Kluwer rose about 3.5 percent as market players bet on positive surprises in the first half results on Tuesday.
Shares touched a record high of 291.70, before easing to 282.60 at 1145 GMT, still up 9.70 guilders from Friday's close.
"Ahead of tomorrow's figures, some are speculating, while others are squaring their positions," one trader said.
Analysts forecast first-half net profit from ordinary operations -- boosted by the firm dollar -- to rise to between 235 and 253 million guilders, from 206 million a year earlier.

After consistently outperforming the Dutch market over the previous 10 years, Wolters Kluwer shares lagged a 33 percent rise in the AEX index in the first half of 1997 with a relatively modest rise of four percent.
